findings.pdf_says: { 1 / 01 } constant-name-1 CONSTANT ... -- both level numbers in the leading brace are underlined (a short underline is printed under the "1" as well as under "01")
findings.why_it_matters: The markdown drops the underline from the level number 1. By §2014:5.2.1/5.2.2 an un-underlined word is optional, and a brace alternative that is optional can be implicitly selected (§2014:5.2.5.2), so the transcription reads as if the level number could be omitted entirely; the printed format requires 1 or 01 to be written.
